name: Abada
description: The Abada is a two-horned, unicorn-like creature from the folklore of the Kongo language area of Central Africa, said to resemble a small donkey and to have horns that serve as antidotes to poison and disease.
origin: Forests and inland regions of the historic Kongo cultural area, including parts of present-day Angola, the Republic of the Congo, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
